# hestiacp_email_account (Resource)

Manages a mail account (mailbox) within a HestiaCP mail domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) Mailbox name (the part before the @).
- `domain` (String) Mail domain this account belongs to.
- `password` (String, Sensitive)

### Optional

- `quota` (Number) Mailbox quota in MB. `0` means unlimited.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username that owns this mail account. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
